Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.security

Class SecurityConfig

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.security.SecurityConfig
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) public class SecurityConfig extends Object
Signs users in with OAuth2 / OpenID Connect login and out with the RP-initiated logout of the authorization server. API calls from the SPA get a 401 instead of a redirect, and every state-changing request must carry the CSRF token the SPA reads from the XSRF-TOKEN cookie. The tokens of the user stay in the HTTP session (persisted by Spring Session JDBC), never in the browser.

  • Method Details

    • bffFilterChain

      @Bean org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain bffFilterChain(org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity http, org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.registration.ClientRegistrationRepository clientRepository, ReturnToAuthenticationSuccessHandler loginSuccessHandler, org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.oidc.web.logout.OidcClientInitiatedLogoutSuccessHandler logoutSuccessHandler) throws Exception
      Builds the BFF filter chain.
      Parameters:
      http - the HTTP security builder.
      clientRepository - the registered OAuth2 clients.
      loginSuccessHandler - sends the browser back to the returnTo of the login once signed in.
      logoutSuccessHandler - redirects the browser to the RP-initiated logout of the authorization server.
      Returns:
      the security filter chain.
      Throws:
      Exception - if the chain cannot be built.

    • authorizedClientRepository

      @Bean org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.web.OAuth2AuthorizedClientRepository authorizedClientRepository()
      Keeps the authorized clients (the tokens of the signed-in user) in the HTTP session, which Spring Session JDBC persists, so no table of its own is needed and the tokens never reach the browser.
      Returns:
      the repository of authorized clients.

    • authorizedClientManager

      @Bean org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.OAuth2AuthorizedClientManager authorizedClientManager(org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.registration.ClientRegistrationRepository clientRepository, org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.web.OAuth2AuthorizedClientRepository authorizedClientRepository)
